    First-order mesh deformations (toward Proposition 12.5) #

    deformation-refinements.tex: "Given a correction tuple z_v ∈ C_{q+2}(τv, v), impose r_v − εz_v over k[ε]/(ε²). Corollary 12.4 makes this a free deformation of C."

    Here C = kQ/(r) is the scalar mesh category, assumed to satisfy the hypothesis of Lemma 12.3 (its mesh presentations are resolutions). The deformation B = kQ[ε]/(𝔪^{N+1}, r − εz) is free over k[ε] with every path basis of C (Corollary 12.4, by base change from k[t]). Writing morphisms of B as ŝ(f) + ε ŝ(g) for a path section ŝ, the ε-part of ŝ(f) ŝ(g) is a Hochschild two-cocycle φ of C, whose mesh value Σ_a c_{x,a} φ(σa, a) is z_x (exists_cocycle).
